reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getMonthWideCategories / forEachMonthWideCategory helpers that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in the single SQL query of getMonthWideCategories; the args shape is factored into one MonthWideActionArgs type.

placement.why: The change lives in the category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts where the other exclusions are decided.

scope.why: Only the selection helper, the six month-wide actions' signatures and targeted tests change.

maintainability.why: A single named parameter on the shared selection function and a shared argument type make the rule easy to find and extend.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions still go through getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the per-action plumbing is only the parameter pass-through.
